entities.summary: Maxime Lajoie is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman for Avangard Omsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Lajoie was chosen 133rd overall by the Ottawa Senators in the 2016 NHL entry draft. He has also played for the Carolina Hurricanes and Toronto Maple Leafs.
